description: A Minecraft datapack that improves the behavior of animals attached with leashes. Mobs follow the player more intelligently, automatically jump over obstacles, and avoid breaking leashes, making transporting animals smooth, cooperative, and finally enjoyable, even over long distances.

mods.name: Easy Leads
mods.description: Improves lead behaviour by enabling leashed entities to jump-block more easily and teleporting them to the player if the leash is about to break.
